## about me

I am currently a PhD candidate in Natural Resources and Environmental Science at the University of Nevada, Reno in the [Blaszczak Lab](https://blaszczaklab.weebly.com/). Broadly, I am interested in the intersection of **water quality**, **public & ecological health**, and **data science**. My dissertation research focuses on understanding and forecasting the timing of toxin-producing cyanobacteria in rivers.

Outside of science, I am an avid rock climber. I also enjoy knitting, crocheting, and reading.
